data: Is the median user response delay (red line) in the ADAPTIVE_LANE condition lower than the median user response delay in the CONTROL_EMPTY condition?

The red line represents the median user response delay for each condition. The median is the middle value of the data set when arranged in order. In the ADAPTIVE_LANE condition, the median appears to be around 1200 ms. In the CONTROL_EMPTY condition, the median appears to be around 1200 ms as well. Comparing these two medians, they appear to be approximately equal. Therefore, the median user response delay in the ADAPTIVE_LANE condition is not lower than the median user response delay in the CONTROL_EMPTY condition.
